title: Agentforce conversation scenario
description: One conversation: its settings (the front matter of a .md file, or the setting columns of a .csv file) and its steps.

name.description: Name of the conversation (default: the file name, or the CSV conversation cell).

surface.description: lightning: the Agentforce panel of Lightning Experience. messaging: an Embedded Messaging widget on a web page. Inferred from site / app / path when left out.

org.description: sf CLI alias or username: the Lightning org, the admin who logs in as the user, or the My Domain of a password login.

user.description: Who is signed in: a username, the part before the @, or a full name. Without credentials, the org's admin logs in as this user (Login-As).

credentials.description: Development only: a file of 'username password  (note)' lines; makes the sign-in a password login. Prefer Login-As.

loginUrl.description: Development only: the login page for a password login (default: My Domain, or <site>login).

authUrl.description: A file holding an sfdx auth URL, authorized as org before the run.

network.description: Experience Cloud site name or Id for a community user's Login-As, when the user belongs to several sites.

agent.description: Lightning only: the agent to talk to (label or API name) when the user has several employee agents. The panel's agent selector is used to pick it.

app.description: Lightning only, optional: the app to open (API name, e.g. c__MyApp). Default: the home page of the user's last app.

path.description: Lightning only, optional: any Lightning path, such as a record page. Wins over app.

site.description: Messaging only: the URL of the page where the Embedded Messaging widget loads.

viewport.description: desktop (1440x900 at 2x), mobile (390x844 at 3x, Messaging only) or WIDTHxHEIGHT.

record.description: What to keep: any of screenshots, video, gif; none keeps only the transcript.

fresh.description: Start clean: end a Messaging chat left open, clear the Lightning panel history (default true).

warmup.description: Messaging: the greeting sent first when the first message isn't one (default Hi); false disables it.

hideLoginAsBanner.description: Lightning Login-As: hide the 'Logged in as ... Log out' banner.

replyTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for an answer (default 180).

settle.description: Seconds without change that end an answer (default 5).

typeDelay.description: Milliseconds per key while a video is recorded (default 35); 0 pastes.

inputTimeout.description: Seconds a type-from step waits for its value (default 600).

fromFile.description: message from type-from: the file it waits for.

prompt.description: message from type-from: asked live in the UI or the terminal.

label.description: click / expect-button: the button label, or /regex/.
